requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-5291-5929--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1278-2438-3327-4508.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-2438-3327-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-2438-3327-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

141-1893-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-5686.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

539-1491-6218-7267.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

618-3899-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-4289-5434-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2232-7827-7831-7837.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7831-7837.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

328-3260-4078-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-3260-4078-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-3260-4078-6797.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

7433-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana, causing each opponent to lose a significant amount of life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
7433-7439.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Exsanguinate.

1453-2829-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-2829-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

944-1718-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Planar Gate.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Planar Gate.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
944-1718-7182-7252.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

1170-1329-4708-4785.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6259-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

5051-5078-6006-6766.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2478-4053-4740-6613.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if you've cast two or more spells this turn, 5 if you've cast one spell this turn, or 7 otherwise.
2478-4053-4740-6613.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0} and 3 life. It will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Mishra's Bauble, and it will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

81-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
81-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

710-772-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

1228-2511-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-2511-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

457-5129-5491.description:
Cast Worldwalker Helm by paying {2}{U}.
When Worldwalker Helm enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Worldwalker Helm and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Worldwaker Helm and a Map, adding {U}{U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus a Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.
457-5129-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

141-2438-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-2438-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-3715-3921-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-3921-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3942-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
2724-3217-3942-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {U}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger when it enters the battlefield due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

1714-3542.notablePrerequisites:
"Blue" chosen with Gauntlet of Power.
You control at least six basic Islands.
1714-3542.description:
Activate six basic Islands by tapping them, adding six {U}.
Gauntlet of Power triggers six times, adding six {U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the six Islands and up to one additional land you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

859-2302-3042.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
"White" chosen with Painter's Servant.
859-2302-3042.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-2292-2452.notablePrerequisites: You have a Zombie card in hand or in your graveyard.
598-2292-2452.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a Zombie from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

225-539-3177-3861.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
